items.prompt: A kitchen dissolving into another place like a projector slide changing mid-click: half of the frame is a plain dacha kitchen with a cup of tea, the other half is an unfamiliar city flat with beige walls and a window onto apartment blocks, the two images overlapping along a soft seam.

alt.ru: Кадр из двух половин: в одной кухня дачи с чашкой чая, в другой чужая городская квартира с бежевыми стенами, по мягкому шву изображения сливаются.
alt.en: One frame in two halves: a dacha kitchen with a cup of tea in one, an unfamiliar city flat with beige walls in the other, blending along a soft seam.
alt.pt: Uma imagem dividida ao meio: numa metade a cozinha da dacha com uma xícara, na outra um apartamento desconhecido na cidade, de paredes bege; as duas metades se fundem numa emenda suave.
alt.es: Una imagen dividida en dos: en una mitad la cocina de la dacha con una taza, en la otra un piso desconocido de ciudad con paredes beige; las dos mitades se funden en una costura suave.
